```ts
import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachLimitedOrbit(

  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
  minDistance: number,
  maxDistance: number
): () => void {

  const removeControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene);

  return () => {
    removeControls();
    removeLimits();
  };
}
```
